verificationQueries.sql: select count(*) = 2 as verified from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and policyname in ('roles_select_members', 'role_permissions_select_members');

select not has_function_privilege('public', 'flower_private.has_organization_permission(uuid,text)', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'flower_private.has_organization_permission(uuid,text)', 'execute') as verified;

rollbackGuidance: Drop the two RBAC select policies, revoke authenticated table privileges, then drop flower_private.has_organization_permission(uuid, text).
